titles.romaji: Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2: Episode N
titles.native: ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ シーズン2 エピソードN

description: In this new series, Satoshi, Pikachu and friends start a new journey towards the "White Ruins." There, they meet the young "N", who can hear the voices from Pokémon's hearts... The door of truth leading to an Utopia for Pokémon and humans now lies open!
